integrity: Exact rational four-good enumeration and symbolic identities independently reconstructed; general three-good dominance is proved algebraically; independently certified publication originality is not claimed.
limitations: Two agents, independent nondegenerate Bernoulli agent-item utilities, common probability between agents for each item. The four-good polynomial compares named allocations, not the global optimizer for every parameter. Literature coverage is conditional on inspected available sources.
title: Sharp four-item failure of expected-fair optimality for ex-post EF1 with Bernoulli lottery goods
